fx-ml-alt: An eye on a mountain at height h above the sea. The last ray of sunlight that reaches it grazes the sea at the tangent point T, an arc φ away seen from the Earth's centre, and bends a further ρ₀ in the air beyond T on its way from the Sun. When the Sun's upper edge is on that ray, its centre is s lower still: the true altitude of the centre is −(φ + ρ₀ + s), below the eye's horizontal
fx-ml-1: true altitude of the Sun's centre at the last flash: −(φ + ρ₀ + s)
